kypExtensions.summary: The pattern/trap/pivot/mini-case attack structure layered over the source facts.
kypExtensions.rationale: First Aid supplies the two comparison rows, the two graphs, and the PEA mnemonic; the attack structure is a KYP design.

kypExtensions.summary: The two-axis reading (the kinetics axis: zero-order = constant AMOUNT eliminated per unit time, Cp ↓ linearly, slope constant at 2 U/h, First t1/2 > Second t1/2 > Third t1/2 with 'Time of t1/2 ↑ as concentration ↑'; first-order = constant FRACTION eliminated per unit time, Cp ↓ exponentially, slope falling 4 U/h → 2 U/h → 1 U/h → 0.5 U/h, First t1/2 = Second t1/2 = Third t1/2 with 'Time of t1/2 is constant as concentration ↑'; and the saturation axis: 'Capacity-limited elimination' [enzymes saturated, Michaelis-Menten at [S] >> Km] vs 'Flow-dependent elimination' [enzymes unsaturated, delivery limits elimination], with the PEA drug set Phenytoin/Ethanol/Aspirin and the aspirin qualifier 'at high or toxic concentrations → ↑ salicylate saturation → zero-order elimination') — KYP's synthesis of the page into one reading protocol.
kypExtensions.rationale: The source prints the two rows and the two graphs sequentially without a unified protocol; the two-axis framing is KYP's design.

kypExtensions.summary: The four KYP mnemonics (1 — A PEA IS ROUND, SHAPED LIKE THE '0' IN ZERO-ORDER [Phenytoin, Ethanol, Aspirin]: the ONE mnemonic that prints verbatim on the page, carried with attribution; 2 — AMOUNT vs FRACTION; 3 — LINE vs CURVE; 4 — CAPACITY vs FLOW: three KYP-original codes that organize the page's own comparison rows and synonyms) — the memory layer adds three original codes over the page's single printed mnemonic.
kypExtensions.rationale: Book 230's Elimination of Drugs section prints exactly ONE mnemonic (the PEA round-pea mnemonic); the other three codes are KYP-original designs.

notes: Census (pdfimages + VLM): NO raster images on the page (pdfimages -list returned zero rows for pdf 252). The Elimination of Drugs section has TWO vector graphs — the zero-order elimination plot (constant 2 U/h slope; First t1/2 > Second t1/2 > Third t1/2; 'Time of t1/2 ↑ as concentration ↑') and the first-order elimination plot (falling slopes 4 U/h → 2 U/h → 1 U/h → 0.5 U/h; First t1/2 = Second t1/2 = Third t1/2; 'Time of t1/2 is constant as concentration ↑') — each redrawn as ORIGINAL_KYP_REDRAW vector graphics in the registry visual (no photographs, no copyrighted artwork reproduced). The zero-order vs first-order comparison rows are pure text and are carried verbatim in the note's table blocks (ORIGINAL_KYP_ADAPTATION). The PEA mnemonic ('A PEA is round, shaped like the “0” in zero-order') prints verbatim on the page — a short attributed phrase carried in the evidence layer and the mnemonic layer, NOT an artwork reproduction; the KYP memory layer ADDS three original codes (AMOUNT vs FRACTION; LINE vs CURVE; CAPACITY vs FLOW). No copyrighted photographs exist on the page; nothing reproduced. NOTE: page 252 (book 230) ALSO contains the Drug Metabolism section (Phase I/Phase II flow diagram), which is covered by the separate PH3 drug-metabolism topic and is NOT covered by this topic's evidence or visual.
